## Constraints

Preserve Keşif Atlası navy and neutral surfaces, Manrope headings and Source Sans 3 controls. Workspaces stay flat. Maintain ownership, feature flags, nullable scores and publication semantics. No new UI, chart, table, calendar or icon packages in this pilot. Hosted AI is off.
